-- fr2052a_submission · compiled for SQL (Spark / Trino / DuckDB)
WITH base AS (
  SELECT * FROM alm.fct_2052a_positions
  WHERE as_of_date = DATE '2026-06-30'
),
d1 AS (
  SELECT *,
    COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', as_of_date, maturity_date), 0) AS days_to_maturity
  FROM base
),
d2 AS (
  SELECT *,
    COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', as_of_date, maturity_date), 0) AS maturity_bucket__days
  FROM d1
),
d3 AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN maturity_date IS NULL
        THEN 'open'
      WHEN maturity_bucket__days <= 1
        THEN 'overnight'
      WHEN maturity_bucket__days <= 7
        THEN 'd2_7'
      WHEN maturity_bucket__days <= 14
        THEN 'd8_14'
      WHEN maturity_bucket__days <= 30
        THEN 'd15_30'
      WHEN maturity_bucket__days <= 90
        THEN 'd31_90'
      WHEN maturity_bucket__days <= 180
        THEN 'd91_180'
      WHEN maturity_bucket__days <= 365
        THEN 'd181_365'
      ELSE 'gt365'
    END AS maturity_bucket
  FROM d2
),
d4 AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN ((((direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND is_secured = FALSE) AND segment = 'RETAIL') AND insured_flag = TRUE) AND account_type = 'TRANSACTIONAL')
        THEN 'O.D.1'  -- OD-1 · 12 CFR 249.32(a)(1)
      WHEN (((direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND is_secured = FALSE) AND segment = 'RETAIL') AND insured_flag = TRUE)
        THEN 'O.D.2'  -- OD-2 · 12 CFR 249.32(a)(1)
      WHEN ((direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND is_secured = FALSE) AND segment = 'RETAIL')
        THEN 'O.D.3'  -- OD-3 · 12 CFR 249.32(a)(2)
      WHEN (((direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND is_secured = FALSE) AND segment = 'SMALL_BUSINESS') AND insured_flag = TRUE)
        THEN 'O.D.5'  -- OD-5 · 12 CFR 249.32(a)(3)
      WHEN ((direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND is_secured = FALSE) AND segment = 'SMALL_BUSINESS')
        THEN 'O.D.6'  -- OD-6 · 12 CFR 249.32(a)(3)
      WHEN ((direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND is_secured = TRUE) AND collateral_class = 'L1')
        THEN 'O.S.1'  -- OS-1 · 12 CFR 249.32(j)
      WHEN ((direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND is_secured = TRUE) AND collateral_class = 'L2A')
        THEN 'O.S.2'  -- OS-2 · 12 CFR 249.32(j)
      WHEN ((direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND is_secured = TRUE) AND collateral_class = 'L2B')
        THEN 'O.S.3'  -- OS-3 · 12 CFR 249.32(j)
      WHEN ((direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND is_secured = TRUE) AND collateral_class = 'NON_HQLA')
        THEN 'O.S.5'  -- OS-5 · 12 CFR 249.32(j)
      WHEN (((direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND is_secured = FALSE) AND account_type = 'OPERATIONAL') AND counterparty_type IN ('NONFIN_CORP', 'SOVEREIGN'))
        THEN 'O.W.1'  -- OW-1 · 12 CFR 249.32(h)
      WHEN ((direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND is_secured = FALSE) AND counterparty_type = 'FINANCIAL')
        THEN 'O.W.3'  -- OW-3 · 12 CFR 249.32(h)(5)
      WHEN ((direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND is_secured = FALSE) AND segment IN ('WHOLESALE', 'RETAIL', 'SMALL_BUSINESS'))
        THEN 'O.W.2'  -- OW-2 · 12 CFR 249.32(h)(2)
      WHEN ((direction = 'INFLOW' AND is_secured = TRUE) AND collateral_class = 'L1')
        THEN 'I.S.1'  -- IS-1 · 12 CFR 249.33(f)
      WHEN (direction = 'INFLOW' AND is_secured = TRUE)
        THEN 'I.S.2'  -- IS-2 · 12 CFR 249.33(f)
      WHEN ((direction = 'INFLOW' AND is_secured = FALSE) AND counterparty_type = 'FINANCIAL')
        THEN 'I.U.1'  -- IU-1 · 12 CFR 249.33(c)
      WHEN ((direction = 'INFLOW' AND is_secured = FALSE) AND segment IN ('WHOLESALE', 'RETAIL', 'SMALL_BUSINESS'))
        THEN 'I.O.1'  -- IO-1 · 12 CFR 249.33(g)
    END AS product_id
  FROM d3
),
d5 AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN product_id = 'O.D.1'
        THEN 0.03  -- 12 CFR 249.32(a)(1)
      WHEN product_id = 'O.D.2'
        THEN 0.03  -- 12 CFR 249.32(a)(1)
      WHEN product_id = 'O.D.3'
        THEN 0.1  -- 12 CFR 249.32(a)(2)
      WHEN product_id = 'O.D.5'
        THEN 0.03  -- 12 CFR 249.32(a)(3)
      WHEN product_id = 'O.D.6'
        THEN 0.1  -- 12 CFR 249.32(a)(3)
      WHEN product_id = 'O.S.1'
        THEN 0  -- 12 CFR 249.32(j)(1)
      WHEN product_id = 'O.S.2'
        THEN 0.15  -- 12 CFR 249.32(j)(2)
      WHEN product_id = 'O.S.3'
        THEN 0.25  -- 12 CFR 249.32(j)(3)
      WHEN product_id = 'O.S.5'
        THEN 1  -- 12 CFR 249.32(j)(4)
      WHEN product_id = 'O.W.1'
        THEN 0.25  -- 12 CFR 249.32(h)(1)
      WHEN product_id = 'O.W.2'
        THEN 0.4  -- 12 CFR 249.32(h)(2)
      WHEN product_id = 'O.W.3'
        THEN 1  -- 12 CFR 249.32(h)(5)
      WHEN product_id = 'I.S.1'
        THEN 0  -- 12 CFR 249.33(f)(1)
      WHEN product_id = 'I.S.2'
        THEN 0.5  -- 12 CFR 249.33(f)
      WHEN product_id = 'I.U.1'
        THEN 1  -- 12 CFR 249.33(c)
      WHEN product_id = 'I.O.1'
        THEN 0.5  -- 12 CFR 249.33(g)
    END AS outflow_rate
  FROM d4
),
d6 AS (
  SELECT *,
    balance_usd * outflow_rate AS weighted_amount
  FROM d5
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  maturity_bucket,
  currency,
  entity_id,
  as_of_date,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(balance_usd) FILTER (WHERE (direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND days_to_maturity <= 30)), 0), 2) AS gross_outflow_balance,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(weighted_amount) FILTER (WHERE (direction = 'OUTFLOW' AND days_to_maturity <= 30)), 0), 2) AS weighted_outflows_30d
FROM d6
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
